coverage_note: Read the transcript from beginning to end. Many stretches are Latin-transliterated Arabic or mixed Arabic/English; there are also long English-only stretches. Chat lines were used for context, not treated as voiced corrections. The Medi line for the route phrase at 36:30 is absent; Amal echoes it as «طريق التاني», so that row uses her echo and notes the omission. Counts are an estimate of Medi turns containing Arabic, including transliterated Arabic.
